transcript.text: Good morning everyone. As you know, next week we need to recertify both our Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator cohorts. We've got two four-hour blocks available in the training area: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. Each cohort needs its own dedicated evaluator, and that evaluator has to be listed on the training schedule. Before I publish the final schedule, I want to make sure we get all our coordination sorted out in this huddle. Who do we have available as evaluators, and are there any conflicts I should know about with either of those time blocks?
